the development of machine learning algorithms for the analysis of genomic data.
the application of deep learning to the problem of understanding the regulatory code of eukaryotes.
the development and application of a deep learning approach for the interpretation of the non-coding human genome.

we developed a machine learning approach for learning the regulatory code from DNase-seq data.
we introduce Basset, an open-source deep convolutional neural network for predicting chromatin accessibility from DNA sequence.
we have introduced the open-source software Basset to apply deep convolutional neural network to learn the regulatory code of accessible genome from DNase-seq data.

deep convolutional neural network (CNN) can be used for the analysis of the regulatory regions of the genome.
